load_jsonl_dataset: load a JSONL file into a Dataset of DictDatum objects using from_jsonl
load_jsonl_with_pattern: load JSONL files matching a glob pattern into a Dataset using from_jsonl
load_jsonl_non_strict: load a JSONL dataset with lenient JSON parsing that skips malformed lines
parse_jsonl_line: parse a single text line into a DictDatum using _from_text_file_line
register_jsonl_source: register the jsonl source type with Dataset using the from_jsonl decorator
